create_lazy_loader: create a lazy_array_loader to memory map and lazily load text data from disk
make_lazy_data: make a lazy version of text data by writing byte offsets to a pickle file
check_lazy_exists: check if a lazy version of a data file already exists on disk
split_strings_by_length: split a concatenated string into individual strings using character length offsets
set_tokenizer_on_loader: set a tokenizer on a lazy_array_loader to preprocess and tokenize fetched strings
